topic.title: How Starlink's Flat Dish Aims at Satellites Without Moving

cta: Which machine should we take apart next? Tell us in the comments
title: How Does Starlink's Flat Dish Aim Without Moving?
subject: Starlink
description:
How does Starlink's flat dish follow satellites racing across the sky without ever turning?
We follow one signal from your laptop up to a Starlink satellite and back, open the dish in 3D, and draw its phased array wave by wave: how many tiny antennas firing a fraction apart bend a beam with no motor.
Then the handoff, when your satellite sets and the next one rises, and how the network grew from its first launch.
